claim: The startup's headcount reached 500 employees last quarter.

sources.passage: The startup's official press release stated headcount reached 500 employees last quarter, calling it a major milestone.
An internal memo leaked to reporters put the startup's actual headcount at closer to 350 employees last quarter, well short of the announced figure.

claim: The company's flagship product runs on version 3 of its software platform.

sources.passage: A 2019 product brochure described the flagship product as running on version 3 of the software platform.
The company's current documentation, updated this year, confirms the flagship product now runs on version 6 of the software platform, following two major upgrades.

claim: The new supplement has been proven to cure the common cold.

sources.passage: Dozens of online customer reviews claim the new supplement cured their common cold within a day.
A peer-reviewed clinical trial published by a national health authority found no statistically significant effect of the supplement on cold duration or symptoms.

claim: The company's customer satisfaction rate is 90%.

sources.passage: Of the customers who responded to the company's optional survey, 90% reported being satisfied.
Independent analysts noted the survey had only an 8% response rate, and satisfaction among a broader customer sample, measured separately, was closer to 60%.

claim: The organization's president is the same person who founded it.

sources.passage: The organization was founded in 2001 by an entrepreneur who served as its first president.
The founder stepped down as president in 2015, and the organization has been led by a different, unrelated president ever since.

claim: The city is the capital of the country and has a population over ten million.

sources.passage: The city has served as the national capital since the country's founding.
Census data places the city's population at approximately three million residents, well under ten million.

claim: The experiment's results were later independently replicated.

sources.passage: The original study reported a measurable effect under laboratory conditions.
A separate research team at a different institution repeated the experiment two years later using the same protocol and reported a consistent effect.

claim: The material's melting point is 1,200 degrees Celsius.

sources.passage: Laboratory measurements place the material's melting point at 1,150 degrees Celsius, with a documented margin of error of only a few degrees.

claim: The merger between the two companies was finalized this year.

sources.passage: Regulators approved the proposed merger between the two companies three years ago.
The deal was later called off entirely last year after both companies mutually agreed not to proceed, and no merger has taken place since.

claim: Meta Platforms acquired the small AI startup last year.

sources.passage: A company called Meta Innovations, unrelated to Meta Platforms, acquired the small AI startup last year in a modest deal.

claim: The vaccine reduces hospitalization risk by 80%.

sources.passage: A wire-service report, syndicated by dozens of outlets, cited health officials stating the vaccine reduces hospitalization risk by roughly 80%.
The same wire-service figure was republished verbatim by another outlet the following week.

claim: Eating more vegetables directly causes longer lifespan.

sources.passage: A long-term observational study found people who ate more vegetables tended to live longer on average.
The study's authors explicitly cautioned that the association could reflect other lifestyle factors correlated with vegetable consumption, not a direct causal effect.

claim: The team finished first in the league this season.

sources.passage: The team won the league championship three seasons ago.
This season's final standings show the team finished fourth, well behind the league leader.

claim: The gene variant is associated with a modestly increased disease risk in some populations.

sources.passage: A genome-wide association study found the variant was associated with a small but statistically significant increase in disease risk in certain studied populations, though the effect size was modest and not observed uniformly across all groups.

claim: The private company's exact annual revenue exceeds two billion dollars.
The unreleased prototype device will launch within six months.
The newly discovered cave system extends more than ten miles underground.

sources.passage: Explorers announced the discovery of a new cave system but have not yet published a total measured length.

claim: The new drug has no side effects.

sources.passage: Clinical trials found the new drug effective for its intended use, but also documented mild side effects, including headache and nausea, in a meaningful share of participants.

claim: The treaty ended the war and established a new international body.

sources.passage: The treaty formally ended hostilities between the warring nations.
Historians note the treaty made no provision for any new international body; that came from a separate agreement signed years later.

claim: The subsidiary operates independently of its parent company's board.

sources.passage: Corporate filings show the subsidiary's board of directors is appointed by, and reports directly to, its parent company's board.

claim: The treatment's success rate is 95%.

sources.passage: Among patients who completed the full treatment course, 95% reported successful outcomes.
A separate analysis noted only 40% of patients who started the treatment actually completed the full course, sharply lowering the success rate across all who began it.

claim: The region's air quality has improved significantly over the past decade.

sources.passage: Government monitoring data shows a significant decline in measured particulate pollution in the region over the past decade.
An independent environmental group's report argues the official monitoring stations are poorly placed and that air quality has not meaningfully improved.

claim: The university's founder still serves as its chancellor.

sources.passage: The university was founded over a century ago by an individual who served as its first chancellor.
The founder died decades ago; the university has since been led by a long succession of unrelated chancellors.

claim: The new processor is the fastest consumer chip ever released.

sources.passage: Benchmark tests show the new processor is the fastest in its manufacturer's lineup to date.
Independent reviewers found a rival company's chip, released the same month, outperforms the new processor on several standard benchmarks.

claim: The exact composition of the newly detected exoplanet's atmosphere is known in full detail.

sources.passage: Astronomers detected an exoplanet and identified faint spectral hints of a few possible gases, but caution the atmospheric composition is not yet well characterized.
